name: De Boor B-spline evaluation
definition: For degree q≥1, nondecreasing knots u_j and x in a positive knot span [u_k,u_(k+1)), set d_j^(0)=c_(k−q+j) for j=0,…,q; for r=1,…,q and j=r,…,q, set α=(x−u_(k−q+j))/(u_(k+1+j−r)−u_(k−q+j)), d_j^(r)=(1−α)d_(j−1)^(r−1)+α d_j^(r−1); S(x)=d_q^(q).
variables: q spline degree; c spline coefficients; u knot sequence; k span index; x query
assumptions: Valid knot and coefficient dimensions, interior nonempty span, all recurrence denominators positive; rightmost endpoint excluded
limitations: Knot multiplicity and endpoint conventions need explicit treatment; only the supplied span is considered
computation: Locate the span and perform triangular local interpolation with descending j if in-place.

source.citation: Provisional locator: Carl de Boor, A Practical Guide to Splines, revised edition (2001). Source review pending.

application: General B-spline evaluation; no forecasting benefit claimed.
required_inputs: Degree, valid knots, coefficients and query
mechanism_note: Provisional local knot-dependent triangular evaluation; novelty and classification review pending.

name: Remez polynomial minimax exchange
definition: For continuous f on [a,b] and d+2 ordered distinct points t_i, solve Σ_(j=0)^d a_j t_i^j+(−1)^i E=f(t_i) for a_j,E. Form P(x)=Σ_(j=0)^d a_j x^j; seek d+2 ordered alternating extrema of f−P and repeat with a justified exchange rule.
variables: d degree bound; a,b interval; t_i exchange nodes; E alternating error; P approximant
assumptions: Continuous real f on nondegenerate compact interval; distinct exchange nodes and a reliable extremum search; explicit stopping rule required
limitations: A sampled extremum search is not a global error certificate; exchange degeneracy and conditioning need handling
failure_conditions: Failure to find justified alternating exchange points
computation: Solve alternating linear system, locate extrema including boundaries and exchange points while maintaining alternation; review exact exchange and termination rules before admission.
application: General uniform polynomial approximation; no forecasting benefit claimed.
required_inputs: Function, interval, degree, initial points and tolerance
incompatible_methods: Claiming global minimax error from a finite sample alone
mechanism_note: Provisional exchange method; specific exchange rule and convergence assumptions require review.
